latestTerminalSummary:
I gave all twelve scores a 9 in round 26: every category, in both light and dark. This report alone doesn't make a second joint pass; the round still needs Sol's report.

| Category | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | 9 | 9 |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |

**App identity:** the only code change since d30dbbe9 is the test file `internal/api/gallery_test.go`. Served assets are still e29fcce0e122.

**What I checked live** (my own tab, now closed), at 1280, 768, 390 and 320, setting light and dark through the browser's color-scheme emulation and confirming the media query each time:
- Library, the card pop-up and card menu, both shared spaces, Search (results and no-match), Add (Agent and Paste) and Settings.
- In the editor: Tags, the Edit tag dialog, Network & permissions, Stored state and assets, the widget panel and Versions.
- Code editor: Find with Next, Go to line (it opened this time, unlike round 25) and autocomplete.
- In the viewer: the pop-up, the More menu, Duplicate, Filters and the full Share dialog.
- Short Share at 320×640, 390×640 and 640×360 in both schemes. It opens at the top with Close focused, wheel-scrolls to the end and reopens at the top. Not every size had every step in both schemes; the report's table has the details.

**Minor things I noticed (none lower a score):**
- In Share, the space under each section heading differs: 8px for Link access, 18px for People, 12px for Saved data.
- Find's Next button is filled, but Go to line's Go button is an outline.
- The disabled Regenerate button explains why it's disabled only in a hover tooltip. That only happens on this scratch server, which has no agent support.
- On the desktop Stored state panel, buttons in the input rows are 44px but standalone buttons like Save state and Export are 36px.

**Not exercised this round:**
- Populated allowed or blocked origin rows, and populated assets.
- Long data, enlarged text, and invalid or unsaved states.
- Replace actions.
- Settings in dark.
- 1280 Search, the URL add mode and the 768 Library grid.

Nothing was saved or changed. The only interactions were a Find query, Go to line and autocomplete, each closed without changes, and "All changes saved" was confirmed afterwards.

Report: [round-26-opus-visual.md](/home/maxomdal/.t3/worktrees/Exhibit/feature-Exh-zrjo-ui-council/docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-26-opus-visual.md)
